caption: The drawing depicts a single top hat placed against a neutral, light-colored background. The top hat is predominantly blue and is decorated with an intricate pattern featuring birds, branches, leaves, and flowers. The birds are rendered in shades of brown, blue, black, and white, and are distributed around the cylindrical body of the hat. The branches and leaves are painted in darker blue and black, with some highlighting in white and light brown. The floral patterns and scroll-like designs appear in a lighter blue or white. The brim of the hat follows the same patterned theme, continuing the botanical and avian motifs around its entire circumference. The surface of the hat shows texture, suggesting fabric or painted material, and the edges display some signs of wear, as indicated by lighter, faded patches. The artist's signature, "J. Rothenberg," appears faintly in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Hat Box
